about.text: Schabziger is a hard, green, strongly flavoured Swiss cheese made only in the canton of Glarus from the Ziger of skimmed milk and powdered blue fenugreek. A Glarus assembly fixed its recipe and origin stamp in 1463, one of the earliest protected brands; today one company, Geska, makes it.
